name: Book-to-Video Code Intelligence
goal: Generate production-ready video code for an entire book without rendering it in this phase.
core_invariants: Every generated concept retains source provenance.
Every lesson references concepts and prerequisites.
Every scene references one or more concepts or explicit pedagogical purpose.
Generated code must be traceable to scene specifications.
The entire book is represented by a persistent manifest, not one giant prompt.
Unsupported source claims are marked unresolved rather than invented.
